annotations.title: Free sample of any paid tool

description: Free, no payment needed. Returns a paid tool's real, live answer to its documented example input (refreshed every 5 minutes to 6 hours depending on the tool), the price of a call with your own input, and where to send it. With no `tool`, lists every paid tool with the URL of its sample. Use it to check a tool's output format and quality before paying, or to test an integration. Also answers GET, e.g. /api/v1/samples?tool=token_risk_check. Rate-limited per client.

tool.description: The paid tool to sample, by name or path, e.g. "token_risk_check" or "email-verify". Leave out to list every tool with its sample.

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).
